name: Glass Hero
tagline: A landing-page hero around an abstract 3D glass object that splits light into vivid rainbows and turns under your cursor.
youSay: /glass-hero A launch page for Spectra, an AI lab whose model sees every colour in an image
whatYouGet: A landing-page hero with a live 3D glass object: prism rods, glass blocks, a ribbed knot or a glass flower
Real dispersive refraction: every edge splits light into its spectrum, in a colour scheme made for the brand
The page around it: brand, headline, copy, call to action, type and layouts for desktop and phone
A static site (HTML, CSS, JS and three.js) you can host anywhere
goodFit: Product launches, AI and tech brands, beauty, events and studios that want a striking first screen
Brands that want something abstract and premium rather than a product photo
notFor: Pages that must work without WebGL or on very old devices
Long scrolling pages or online shops
youBring: Optional: the brand name, colours and tone
